description: A shell script for uploading logs via HTTP/HTTPS, including TLS handling, retries, and log compression. It manages log file creation, upload attempts, and cleanup, with specific handling for different device types and network conditions.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp to the specified log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on curl error codes.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Performs a TLS connection attempt to the SSR server using curl.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, handling retries and S3 upload process.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles log upload process during reboot, including compression and cleanup.
